<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to the protonated ion [M + H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈192.103 Da. Searching for plausible formulas composed of C, H, and O that match this mass, the best fit is C₈H₁₆O₅ (exact mass = 192.0998 Da, within a few millidaltons of the observed value). No other heteroatoms are indicated, so the formula is reported as C8H16O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H16O5</final_answer>
